The Minions bring their signature chaos, comedy, and banana-loving fun to all five Universal Studios parks around the globe. Each destination offers its own version of Minion mischief—whether you're wandering through Illumination’s Minion Land at Universal Studios Florida, snapping selfies in Minion Land at Universal Hollywood, or stepping into the bright, playful world of Minion Park at Universal Studios Japan. Universal Studios Singapore and Universal Beijing Resort also offer their own vibrant Minion Lands, complete with themed treats, interactive zones, and attractions the whole family will love.


Contact us today HERE to craft your own Universal Studios story—perhaps this is the beginning of a bucket-list journey to visit every Universal Studios Destination around the world.

Follow in the tiny yellow footsteps of the Minions as you explore London, the city that inspired many memorable scenes in the 2015 Minions movie. Wander past iconic landmarks such as the Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, and Westminster Abbey, imagining the Minions darting through the streets on their wonderfully chaotic missions. London’s rich history, vibrant culture, and playful charm make it the perfect backdrop for a story filled with laughter, adventure, and mischief.


Click HERE to begin writing your own London chapter.
